    Classroom host guide

    1. Before play, choose your team count and names. Optionally enable “2 hidden Daily Doubles.” Two randomly chosen $200–$500 tiles become wager clues. Settings lock after play begins; start a new game to change them.
    2. Name your teams and choose a dollar tile. The clue opens without revealing its answer.
    3. Start the optional 60-second timer. Pause or reset it as needed. The timer never reveals an answer automatically.
    4. Reveal the original answer, select a team and award points. Correct adds the clue value, marks it played and returns to the board. Incorrect subtracts the value and keeps the clue open for a rebound.
    5. Use “Mark played & return” for unscored clues. Played tiles remain available to review. “Return tile to board” makes a clue available again.
    6. For a Daily Double, choose the team and lock a whole-dollar wager before seeing the clue. The limit is the higher of $500 or that team’s score. One attempt adds or subtracts the wager and ends the clue. The wager, attempts and score history travel with a score backup.
    7. Score history shows every award, penalty and correction. Each team can attempt an ordinary clue once; choose another team for a rebound. Use Undo for a mistaken judgment, or apply a score correction with a reason.
    8. Undo reverses the latest score or played-tile change. New game resets scores and the board, keeping team names.

    Keyboard: Escape returns to the board. Space reveals the answer when a clue is open. Tab navigates buttons. Progress saves in this browser when local storage is available. Save scores downloads a portable backup. Restore scores recovers it on this or another computer. Keep a backup after each category.
